biography:
Gnoomes is a psychedelic rock band from Perm, Russia, known for blending space rock, shoegaze, neo-psychedelia, krautrock, and electronic textures into a style they have described as “stargaze.” Formed in 2014 by Sasha Piankov, Pasha Fedoseev, and Dima Koniushevich, the group emerged from the Perm underground with a sound built on motorik rhythms, atmospheric guitars, pulsing synths, and a melodic but expansive approach to psychedelia.

Their first cassette EP, It’s Moonbow-Time, Boy, appeared in 2014, followed by their debut full-length Ngan! in 2015. Gnoomes gained wider attention through Rocket Recordings in the UK and continued developing their sound on albums such as Tschak!, MU!, and Ax Ox, each pushing further into experimental, cosmic, and dance-inflected territory. Their significance lies in bringing a distinct Russian perspective to modern psych music while bridging garage-psych energy with shoegaze haze and electronic drive.
